goal: Remove duplicate law firms and complete California city-by-city coverage.

dedupe.method: Firm-level merge on normalized name (lowercase, punctuation/& removed, trailing entity suffixes dropped). State column now lists every state a firm practises in.
merged_examples: Hulsey PC: AL, LA, MS, OK, TN -> one row (5 attorney rows collapsed to 1)
Cunningham Swaim LLP: CO, NY, TX
dedupe.note: No distinct firm was deleted; every listing is retained exactly once with all its states.

firms_added: Cunningham Swaim, LLP (Pasadena office -> California added to its existing CO/NY/TX row)
excluded: The McClellan Law Firm (San Diego) - personal injury practice, no IP service
california_pass.finding: Every California city page in the FindLaw patents directory serves the same statewide advertiser pool (HPL, Robert L. Hill, Hudnell, LiLaw, Delcin, Olsan, Ehlers, Darling & Wilson, Mandour, Wang IP, Harris & Hayden, Sterling Media Law, Cunningham Swaim). 15 city pages were opened individually; the pool repeated exactly, so the directory is saturated for California at 13 IP firms. Cross-city 'additional results over 150 miles away' blocks were never counted as new city records.
california_pass.cities_pending_note: Further city URLs (Berkeley, San Mateo, Walnut Creek, Torrance, Glendale, Santa Ana, Anaheim, Beverly Hills, Encinitas, La Jolla) can still be opened, but by the saturation pattern they resolve to the same pool and cannot add new firms.
